frame.description: site-center ENU, azimuth from grid north; Sun/Earth vectors are for the site center, rotate them by a point's up_tilt (its up as [east, north] parts) to use them there

terrain.order: row-major; row j: y = y0 + j*spacing (south->north); column i: x = x0 + i*spacing (west->east)
terrain.z: metres along the site-center up vector, relative to the observer's ground (0 at the center); includes the Moon's curvature

terrain_detail.order: row-major; row j: y = y0 + j*spacing (south->north); column i: x = x0 + i*spacing (west->east)
terrain_detail.z: metres along the site-center up vector, relative to the observer's ground (0 at the center); includes the Moon's curvature
